'''Vuk Dimitrius''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who was stationed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], where he asked a fellow Imperial to deal with [[Exchange]] forces under [[Kiregan Freem]].<ref name="TOR" />
